description: Election Commission - The Media Guidelines made by the Election Commission
reasoning: This gazette contains Media Guidelines issued by the Election Commission under Article 104B of the Constitution. The content specifically addresses electoral processes, including regulations for media conduct during election periods, requirements for balanced coverage of political parties and candidates, restrictions on polling station photography, and rules for opinion poll reporting. This falls squarely under "Electoral processes and related matters" as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
